test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The President can nominate not more than ______ members from the Anglo-Indian community if he/she feels that the said community is not adequately represented in the House of the people.
solution:
The correct answer is **__2__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Between **1952 and 2020,** **two seats **in the **Lok Sabha,** the lower house of the Indian Parliament, were reserved for Anglo-Indians.
 
• These **two nominees** were put forth by the Indian **President **at the government's suggestion.
 
• The President of India may propose **no more than two members** of the** Anglo-Indian community** if, in his/her judgement, that community is not sufficiently represented in the House.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• The Anglo-Indian reserved seats in the Indian Parliament and State Legislatures **disappeared **in **January 2020 **thanks to the **126th Constitutional Amendment Bill of 2019,** which was signed into law as the **104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019.**
 
• At the time of the Indian Constitution's ratification, **Article 331 **provided the Anglo-Indian community a reserve; however, this **reservation **would **end ten years after **the Constitution's inception. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **Anglo-Indian community **was the only one in India to nominate candidates for the** Lok Sabha,** or lower chamber, of the **Indian Parliament.**
 
• J**awaharlal Nehru **granted this authority to **Frank Anthony**, the All India Anglo-Indian Association's first and longest-serving president.
 
• The **representatives **of the community were** two people.**
 
• This was carried out since the town lacked a **native state** of its own.
 
• Each of the **14 Indian states** (Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal) also had a **nominated **representative in their **respective State Legislative Assemblies.**
